##### Project general facts

Al Zorah Seaside Hills is a beachfront residential community offering apartments and villas in a barefoot luxury setting, ideal for wholesome wellbeing. The apartments are arranged in low-rise buildings of varying heights that cascade above the villa rooftops, giving residents terraces with expansive views across the sea to the horizon. The project offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments alongside villas, all shaped by a contemporary, simple yet refined design language.

The secluded community is built around a dedicated communal space. Residents enjoy an indoor and outdoor gym fitted with modern equipment, together with a community club featuring an adult swimming pool and a children's pool. An outdoor playground offers space for families, and a landscaped pedestrian-friendly road brings neighbours together. Direct access to a private beach, water sports facilities, gardens and a long cycling and running track completes the offer.

Interiors are light-filled and finished in a neutral palette that highlights the quality of the materials and creates a calm, relaxing atmosphere. Airy layouts balance indoor and outdoor living, framing sea views while keeping spaces comfortable and tranquil. Spacious terraces extend living areas outdoors, and homes are designed to suit both private family life and entertaining guests. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is an award-winning mixed-use coastal destination in Ajman, combining a white sandy beachfront, an inland creek and a protected mangrove forest that is home to a wide range of birds and marine life. Landscaped gardens and meandering pathways cover much of the community, creating a green, healthy setting for everyday life. Calm, clear waters invite swimming, diving and snorkelling for much of the year.

The Nicklaus Design championship golf course, The Oberoi Beach Resort, the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort and several marinas are located within the community. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai and both Sharjah and Dubai international airports, while Ajman City Centre, schools, universities and hospitals are a short drive away, and the community is also accessible by boat through its marinas.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Beachfront homes with sea views and resort amenities attract families, retirees and holiday home buyers. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, together with a mature lifestyle offer, support steady demand, healthy rental yields and long-term value for owners.
